# The I/O the engine and the wire still perform, read by TestIOBoundary in
# io_boundary_test.go. One line per file and denied identifier, with the
# number of references: file, identifier, count, separated by tabs.
#
# This file can only shrink. A change that removes an I/O reference lowers
# or deletes its line in the same commit, and the test fails until it does.
# Do not add a line: take the new I/O through an interface the host
# implements (decision 0021, rule 1). CI's Engine boundary guard
# (cmd/terva-boundary-guard) fails a change that adds a line or raises a
# count, unless a commit on the branch carries `Boundary-Grows: <reason>`.
#
# Seeded from origin/sothr-main at 8ae116db on 2026-09-23.
#
# Empty since TKT-01M35WK0T moved the JSONL session store to packages/session
# (2026-09-23): the engine and the wire perform no file, environment or
# process I/O. Keep it that way.
